Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix wizard and buff selection multiplayer sync issues

Major refactoring to fix RPC calls from dynamically created nodes.

## Problem
Wizard/buff selection scenes were stuck after players made choices. RPCs
sent from dynamically created RewardManager nodes were never received by
the server or other clients, causing the game to freeze.

## Root Cause
Godot cannot reliably route RPC calls to/from dynamically created nodes
\(nodes created with Node.new\(\)\). RPCs work by matching node paths in the
scene tree, but dynamic nodes don''t have stable, synchronized paths.

## Solution - Signal Relay Pattern
Refactored all RPC calls to use a "signal relay" pattern:
1. Dynamic node emits signal when action occurs
2. Scene node \(stable path\) receives signal
3. Scene node calls RPC, which works reliably

## Files Changed

**New Reward System** \(scripts/rewards/\):
- reward_manager.gd - Manages spectator/private reward modes
  - Emits signals instead of calling RPCs directly
  - Handles reward choice application and ready state tracking
- reward_choice.gd - Data class for reward options \(cards, heals, buffs\)
- reward_display_panel.gd - Reusable UI component for displaying choices

**Wizard Scene** \(scripts/reward.gd\):
- Added RPC handlers for spectator rewards \(rare card selection\)
  - server_receive_spectator_choice\(\) - Server receives choice from client
  - client_notify_spectator_complete\(\) - Broadcast completion to all clients
- Added RPC handlers for private rewards \(common/heal selection\)
  - server_receive_private_choice\(\) - Server receives choice from client
  - client_update_ready_status\(\) - Broadcast ready status to all clients
  - client_all_players_ready\(\) - Notify all clients when everyone is done

**Buff Selection Scene** \(scripts/buff_selection.gd, scenes/buff_selection.tscn\):
- New scene shown after defeating minions
- Players choose: +1 Energy, +15 HP, or Rare Card
- Uses same signal relay pattern as reward scene
- Properly transitions to boss fight \(not reward scene\)

**Documentation** \(.claude/CLAUDE.md\):
- Added comprehensive entry in Hard Problems Log
- Documented RPC failure symptoms, root cause, and solution pattern
- Added to Multiplayer Debugging Tips
- Updated Current Priorities - marked wizard/buff scenes as completed

## Testing
✅ Rare card selection \(spectator mode\) - one player chooses, others watch
✅ Common/heal selection \(private mode\) - each player chooses independently  
✅ Buff selection after minions - each player chooses their buff
✅ All scenes properly synchronized across multiplayer clients
✅ Correct flow: Minions → Buff Selection → Boss Fight → Wizard Rewards

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
